title: The Port paid before receiving 21 of 51 certified payrolls tested on a clean-water grant

beats.text: Federal recovery funding helped the Port redirect wastewater at Pier 45.
The state listed $1,548,645 for the sewer project.
The City reported its annual federal program expenditures separately.

visual.kicker: The state identified recovery funding for Pier 45 improvements

beats.text: Auditors tested 51 certified payrolls under the Port’s clean-water grant.

visual.kicker: The Port paid before it received 21 of 51 certified payrolls tested

beats.text: In 21 instances the Port made payment before receiving the certification.
Waiting for payroll gives officials a chance to check wages before paying.
